The '''Corlax system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the resource-abundant [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Corlax 4]].
